prompt: Stage 2-5, level 5, 9 gold. The shop has no copy of anything you own and nothing that fits your traits. A friend watching says 'just refresh, it is only 2 gold'. What do you do?

options.label: Keep the 9 gold: a free shop arrives next round, and 2 gold is a fifth of what you have
Refresh once: 2 gold is nothing and you might find a pair
Refresh until you find a copy of something you own
Buy the 2-cost tank so the gold at least does something

explanation:
A refresh costs 2 gold, and the free shop arrives anyway at the start of every round. At 9 gold one refresh is a fifth of your money for maybe a one-in-four chance at a copy, and 'refresh until you hit' reaches zero within three rounds. Holding also keeps you on course for 10 gold, where interest starts.

'It is only 2 gold' is the sentence that empties every beginner's wallet: no single refresh hurts, and twenty of them are a level-up you never bought. Refresh when you are hunting a named champion with a plan; otherwise let the shop come to you.
principle: The shop refreshes for free every round; paying 2 gold to see it early needs a reason.
commonMistake: Refreshing 'just once' every round in stage 2 and arriving at stage 3 with no gold and no interest.
hint: Work out how many refreshes 9 gold buys, and what you would earn next round if you held it.
